overall: The AG found the Board could no longer rely on the Open Meeting Law to withhold the Nov. 19 and Dec. 2, 2019 executive session minutes, and ordered their release unless privilege or a Public Records exemption applies.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to release the Nov. 19, 2019 and Dec. 2, 2019 executive session minutes after the purpose for the sessions had concluded.
Board contended the complaint was never properly filed because it was not received by the Board within the 30-day window; the AG rejected this objection.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the complaint was properly filed and thus review its merits.

remedy: Release the November 19, 2019 and December 2, 2019 executive session meeting minutes, unless the attorney-client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
remedy_passage: we order the Board to release the November 19, 2019, and December 2, 2019, executive session meeting minutes, unless the attorney-client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
